edition.window: Orders and decisions passed or reported between 10:00 AM IST on 25 September 2026 and 11:00 AM IST on 26 September 2026

items.caseName: In the matter of Vidarbha Industries Power Limited
items.coram: Vinay Goel (Judicial Member) & Charanjeet Singh Gulati (Technical Member)
items.headline: Vidarbha Industries Power's merger into Adani Power sanctioned
items.text: The Mumbai bench sanctioned the amalgamation of Vidarbha Industries Power with Adani Power, one of ten group companies being folded into it. It found the scheme fair, reasonable and not contrary to law, with 1 April 2025 as the appointed date.

items.caseName: India1 Payments Limited v. Registrar of Companies
items.coram: Sunil Kumar Aggarwal (Judicial Member) & Radhakrishna Sreepada (Technical Member)
items.headline: Capital reduction approved to let an investor fund exit
items.text: The tribunal approved India1 Payments' cancellation of about 4.5 crore equity shares held by an investor fund for roughly ₹69.99 crore. The reduction was sought at the investor's request to allow a partial exit in line with SEBI directions on winding up the fund.

items.caseName: M.K. Nazar v. Indiavision Satellite Communications Limited
items.coram: Vinay Goel (Judicial Member) & Ravichandran Ramasamy (Technical Member)
items.headline: Insolvency plea against Indiavision fails: financial debt not proved
items.text: The petitioner said he advanced ₹1.5 crore to clear the company's service tax dues. The tribunal found discrepancies in the documents, no board authorisation and no bank records proving the transfer, so the financial debt was not established.

items.caseName: Aegon Shipping India Private Limited v. Commissioner of Customs (General)
items.coram: Ajay Sharma (Judicial Member) & M.M. Parthiban (Technical Member)
items.headline: No demurrage on customs-seized goods, even after 60 days
items.text: A customs cargo service provider may not charge rent or demurrage on goods seized by Customs under the Handling of Cargo in Customs Areas Regulations, 2009, whatever the 60-day recovery rule says. Suspension of the NVOCC's registration was upheld.

items.coram: Sushil Mahadeorao Kochey (Judicial Member) & Prabhat Kumar (Technical Member)
items.headline: Parle demerger-and-merger scheme sanctioned
items.text: The tribunal sanctioned a composite scheme demerging specified undertakings and amalgamating Parle Products with Parle Biscuits. It found the scheme fair, reasonable and not against law or public policy.

items.caseName: Small Industries Development Bank of India v. Vyshnavi Spices LLP
items.coram: Kishore Vemulapalli (Judicial Member) & Umesh Kumar Shukla (Technical Member)
items.headline: Leasehold rights in land count as the company's assets
items.text: In SIDBI's Section 7 proceedings against Vyshnavi Spices, the tribunal allowed the application and directed liquidation. It held that leasehold rights in land are to be treated as assets of the company under accounting standards.

items.caseName: State Bank of India v. Pangea Fabrics India Pvt. Ltd.
items.coram: Rajeev Bhardwaj (Judicial Member) & Sanjay Puri (Technical Member)
items.headline: Missing postal receipt doesn't invalidate a demand notice
items.text: The corporate debtor questioned SBI's standing to enforce a corporate guarantee over an alleged default of more than ₹732 crore. The tribunal upheld SBI's locus and held that the lack of a separate postal receipt or acknowledgement does not invalidate the demand notice.

items.caseName: State Bank of India v. Suryajyoti Infotech Ltd.
items.coram: Rajeev Bhardwaj (Judicial Member) & Sanjay Puri (Technical Member)
items.headline: Notice showed intent to enforce guarantee; CIRP admitted
items.text: In a Section 7 petition over a default of about ₹732 crore, the tribunal read the notice as showing the lender meant to enforce the guarantors' liability. The petition was admitted.

items.caseName: Naksh Steel Ltd. v. Auri Grow India Ltd.
items.coram: Brajendra Mani Tripathi (Judicial Member) & Man Mohan Gupta (Technical Member)
items.headline: CIRP against Auri Grow India over ₹78 crore supply dues
items.text: Auri Grow disputed the interest charged but could not deny the underlying operational debt under a Master Supply Agreement. The tribunal admitted the petition and declared a moratorium.

items.caseName: Chellanam Service Cooperative Bank v. Income Tax Officer, Non Corp Ward 2(4)
items.coram: Prashant Maharishi (Vice President) & Keshav Dubey (Judicial Member)
items.headline: Section 80P claim sent back to the AO for a fresh look
items.text: The AO had denied a primary agricultural credit society's Section 80P(2)(a)(i) deduction for want of documents without examining its accounts. The ITAT remanded the issue and gave the society 90 days to file full details.

items.caseName: Keshav Khaneja v. Mufin Green Finance Limited
items.coram: Shammi Khan (Judicial Member) & Sanjeev Sharma (Technical Member)
items.headline: Forensic audit ordered in Gensol–Mufin deposit dispute
items.text: The tribunal appointed an independent forensic auditor to find when Mufin adjusted Gensol Engineering's ₹1.34 crore security deposit. The answer decides whether the adjustment breached the moratorium that began on 13 June 2025.

items.caseName: The Cosmos Co-op. Bank Ltd. v. Rajendra Singhal
items.coram: Brajendra Mani Tripathi (Judicial Member) & Man Mohan Gupta (Technical Member)
items.headline: Guarantor can't escape liability for lack of personal benefit
items.text: Whether a personal guarantor gained anything from the loan is irrelevant to enforcing the guarantee. The tribunal admitted the insolvency application against the guarantor.
